agents.label: opencode/mimo-v2.5-free
agents.cmd: opencode run -m opencode/mimo-v2.5-free 'Read PROBLEM.md and dut.py. Then write dut.v: a complete synthesizable SystemVerilog module named dut implementing the operator exactly as specified, with the exact port list from PROBLEM.md. Run ./check.sh to test your work and iterate until it passes. Do not use simulator-only constructs (initial, #delay, $display).'
